curves: Vb = 0 curves per device (I8-1 curve set): Id-Vg at |Vd| 0.1 and 1.8 V (keys idvg@d0, d1; |Vg| 0-1.8 V, 10 mV, 181 points) and Id-Vd at |Vg| 0, 0.3, ..., 1.8 V (keys idvd@g0..g6; |Vd| 0-1.8 V, 20 mV, 91 points); npz holds the raw stored sign
inclusion_measured_rule: pdk2.metric: clean_current, trim to the first |I| > 1e-10 A, include iff trimmed mean |I| > 3e-7 A (Id-Vd) / 2e-7 A (Id-Vg)

bin_rt.rule: covered: the geometry lies in a closed bin box (1e-6 um tolerance); bin = the bin ngspice selects with the full card (eta0 sentinel readback when several boxes share an edge); uncovered: nearest bin in (ln L, ln W)
